members._note: host: answered by a subagent the chair agent dispatches itself (e.g. Claude when Claude Code is the chair). Agent mode only; `run` skips it.

members._note: cli + codex preset: uses your ChatGPT subscription via the Codex CLI (install and log in first).

members._note: openai type: any OpenAI-compatible API. effort_style: effort / toggle / effort+toggle / none.
